old_problem: Generic rasdaemon/EDAC inventory neither runs NVRAS nor proves 100%. The unavailable NVRAS contract may mix passive observation with destructive fault injection, while targets, severities, propagation, containment, recovery and denominator are undefined.
disposition_reason: The purpose is identifiable, but parameterizing an unknown RAS suite is not sufficient: whether each operation observes state or injects a CPU, memory, PCIe or GPU fault determines the core command semantics and blast radius. ED-16 requires an approved injection tool, isolated environment and recovery; ED-15 forbids a PASS threshold without an authoritative denominator. These are execution-defining specifications rather than ordinary runtime values, so Pending remains truthful.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2155, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2156 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP SW-00004-V002 / b1bfc6f6fb81f054 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Owner must supply the authentic NVRASTool build/license, exact procedure and fixed expected-test manifest.

For every suite item, specify passive versus injecting behavior, exact physical/logical target, error type/severity, mechanism, expected hardware/firmware/kernel/device/BMC propagation, containment, abort and recovery.
Active injection is independently closed until the approved tool, isolated maintenance SUT, target verification, OOB control and tested recovery are authorized under ED-16.
Define PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR accounting and any waiver before execution; 100% cannot be inferred from a vendor summary.
Preserve pre-existing logs and complete first-event chains; reject the source log-clear step, truncated output, insecure access and automatic retry/reinjection.
No NVRASTool, rasdaemon query, log clearing, injection, reset, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Event-chain-bound NVRAS server RAS capability qualification
test_case.purpose: Qualify required server CPU, memory, PCIe, GPU and management RAS behavior with the approved NVRAS suite, proving correct detection, severity, propagation, containment and recovery for every authorized capability and a genuine 100% result over a fixed manifest.
required_package: Authentic pinned NVRASTool build/hash/license and exact suite procedure/configuration
Signed platform RAS capability matrix and fixed expected-test manifest
Per-test passive/injection target, severity, event-chain oracle, containment and recovery contract
Compatible firmware/kernel/driver/rasdaemon/EDAC stack and complete host/device/BMC collectors
Isolated maintenance SUT, trusted OOB recovery and separate injection approvals
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Preserve complete RAS baselines and perform no injection or log clearing. After approval, run passive observations first; execute each explicitly approved active stimulus exactly once against its verified target while correlating the complete hardware/firmware/kernel/device/BMC event chain. Reconcile every result state to the frozen manifest before calculating 100%.
test_case.expected_result: Every required capability produces its approved complete event chain, severity, containment and recovery result, and every manifest item is PASS under the signed denominator with no unexpected escalation, missing evidence or silently excluded state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No verdict until suite semantics, event oracles, recovery and accounting are authoritative. PASS requires every manifest item and event chain to meet the signed oracle and 100% denominator. FAIL on any unwaived non-PASS, incorrect/missing propagation, failed containment/recovery or unexpected fault. Missing core contracts remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED for all active stimuli until ED-16 approvals, isolation, target identity, OOB control and recovery are signed.
Preserve logs/counters; never clear the only baseline or first-fault evidence.
Execute one approved stimulus at a time and stop on wrong target, unexpected severity/escalation, uncontained error, hang, reboot or data risk.
No automatic retry, reinjection or device reset.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVRASTool provenance and fixed manifest
Platform RAS capability/compatibility matrix and per-test passive/injection contract
Per-test target/parameters/timestamps and complete hardware-to-BMC causal event chain
Full result-state reconciliation and signed 100% calculation
Containment/recovery or stable final state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve all evidence on any unexpected event. Use only the target-specific signed containment/recovery path from trusted OOB control; quarantine the SUT if state cannot be restored and do not clear logs, reset, retry or reinject to manufacture a passing result.
